generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
THE TENDERER SHOULD POSSESS VALID ELECTRICAL LICENCE (Class III and above)

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

MANDATING SATISFACTORY COMPLETION AS A PRIME CONTRACTOR FOR AT LEAST ONE SIMILAR NATURE WORK SUCH AS ELECTRICAL WIRING TO AN EXTENT OF 50% OF THE COST OF THE WORK, RS. 9.31 LAKHS IN LAST 5 YEARS (2021-22 to 2025-26).The bidder shall submit a Work Completion Certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Government Department or Institution as proof of such experience.

THE TENDERER SHALL SUBMIT THE TURNOVER CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY AUTHORISED CA AND MUST HAVE ACHIEVED IN AT LEAST TWO FINANCIAL YEARS A MINIMUM FINANCIAL TURN OVER OF RS.18,61,000 IN ANY OF THE LAST FIVE YEARS (2021-22 to 2025-26) USUALLY NOT LESS THAN THE AMOUNT PUT TO TENDER UNDER THIS CONTRACT
FOR DETAILS REFER TENDER NOTIFICATION AND CONDITIONS IN THE BID DOCUMENTS.
ACCEPTANCE / CANCELLATION OF THE WORKS ARE RESERVED BY EXECUTIVE ENGINEER PRED KARWAR WITHOUT ANY REASONS FOR THE SAME.
CORRIGENDUMS / MODIFICATIONS / CORRECTION, IF ANY, WILL BE PUBLISHED IN THE WEBSITE ONLY.

ALL THE SCANNED DOCUMENTS PERTAINING TO BIDDER TO BE UPLOADED SHALL BE IN ORIGINAL AND SAME ORIGINALS SHOULD BE PRODUCED TO THE EXECUTIVE ENGINEER (AT THE TIME OF TECHNICAL BID OPENING) WHO RESERVES RIGHT TO VERIFY THE ORIGINAL DOCUMENTS BEFORE APPROVAL.
TO QUALIFY FOR AWARD OF THIS CONTRACT EACH TENDERER SHOULD GIVE ALL DETAILS AND DOCUMENTS AS PER TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL BID ATTACHED TO THIS TENDER.
IF ANY DATE IN THE TENDER TIME TABLE IS GOVERNMENT HOLIDAY, NEXT WORKING DATE WILL BE CONSIDERED
INCOMPLETE / CONDITIONAL TENDERS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.
TENDERER MUST SUBMIT HIS PRESENT ACCURATE POSTAL ADDRESS AND PHONE / CELL PHONE NUMBER
THE TENDER MAY BE CANCELLED AT ANY STAGE WITHOUT ASSIGNING ANY REASON
THE TENDERERS MUST SUBMIT THE SCANNED DOCUMENTS IN PDF / JPEG FORM, NOT IN OTHER FORM.
ANY OBJECTION REGARDING THE TENDER MUST BE SUBMITTED DIRECTLY TO EXECUTIVE ENGINEER , NOT IN INWARD.
FOR INTERPRETATIONS OF CLAUSES, CONDITIONS, SPELLING MISTAKES, ETC., DECISION OF EXECUTIVE ENGINEER PRED KARWAR IS FINAL.
GST SHALL PAID SEPARATELY AS PER THE PREVAILING RATES
ALL OTHER CONDITIONS AS PER KW TENDER DOCUMENT
GST AND PAN REGISTRATION DOCUMENT SHALL BE SUBMITTED BY THE SUPPLIER.
TENDERER MUST HAVE ASSESSED AVAILABLE TENDER CAPACITY OF 18.62 LAKHS OR MORE WHICH WILL BE CALCULATED AS PER FORMULA IN SECTION 3.1
UNCONDITIONAL LIQUID ASSETS/BANK LINE OF CREDIT FROM ANY NATIONALIZED/SCHEDULED BANK MUST BE SUBMITTED AS PER KW BID DOCUMENT 30% of AMOUNT PUT TO TENDER i.e. 5.59LAKHS.
